group.name: Backend API <-> Database
group.modules: src/app.js (routes)  ->  auth / products / orders modules  ->  src/db.js (users, sessions, products, orders tables)
group.strategy: Bottom-Up Integration: db.js and the modules were already verified (unit + component); now the Express routes are integrated on top and checked against the DB state.
group.dataPassed: Route params/JSON body -> module calls -> DB rows (users, sessions, products, orders); DB rows -> JSON responses

cases.title: POST /api/register persists a user row with hashed password
cases.objective: Verify that API calls read/write the correct records in the database tables
cases.pre: DB seeded before each test; requests sent with supertest
cases.steps: 1. Prepare state (see Preconditions)  2. Perform the actions listed in Test Data  3. Compare the output with Expected Result
cases.expected: db.users has 1 row, email "sara@test.com", passwordHash != plain password
